# Copilot Review Effort Auditor 1.0.0

Copilot Review Effort Auditor traces GitHub Copilot code review effort through request, pull-request, user, repository, organization, and built-in precedence. It identifies Default-to-Balanced exposure, estimates evidence-bound AI-credit ranges, and produces a controlled verification and rollback plan without changing GitHub settings.

## Assets

- `copilot-review-effort-auditor-1.0.0.ipollowork-plugin` — direct iPolloWork file import.
- `copilot-review-effort-auditor-1.0.0-skill.zip` — standalone Skill folder archive.
- `copilot-review-effort-auditor-1.0.0-source.zip` — development source.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — SHA-256 checksums for all three archives.
